summary: Independent implementation review passed within the P0–P4 packet scope. All six discovered defects were corrected and rechecked. Independently executed focused protocol regressions passed 12/12 before the last narrow recovery fix and 8/8 against the final recovery code. Browser demo sources and the supplied run index were inspected; browser runs were not independently re-executed. P5 remains outside this review.

evidence.observation: AC/case/method/environment/check references and required scopes are validated. Upgrade drafts retain command identities while leaving unknown cases/environments incomplete.
Delivery v1 returns ACCEPTANCE_MIGRATION_REQUIRED and cannot acquire v2 acceptance through historical runs.

evidence.location: v2 rejects lost ACs, invented methods, unscheduled cases and engineering-as-acceptance
evidence.observation: This reviewer executed the regression successfully in the 12-test focused run.
A new attempt clears previous attempt results and review state; DONE and idempotent replays validate current attempt evidence before admission.
V2 final admission now requires both task status=passed and reviewStatus=passed, closing the running-repair counterexample.
Direct final transition, approval and completion paths invoke final readiness checks.

evidence.location: CLI cannot skip acceptance; DONE waits for every task check
evidence.observation: Independently executed controller and task-admission regressions passed.

Required case matches include stable ID, source file and browser project. Clean results reject skips/retries/flaky/expected failures; observed environment, mock hits and live-response substitution are checked.
Consumption rechecks raw-report and attachment fingerprints and compares normalized cases against the raw report.

evidence.location: zero-exit without fresh report or with only skipped tests never proves acceptance
evidence.observation: The independently executed negative protocol regression passed.
Inputs are captured before execution, verified after execution, and complete records are atomically written before ledger references. Recovery validates durable evidence without rerunning commands.
Consumption verifies the input snapshot and evidence bytes and selects the latest matching scoped run; a newer failure/running record cannot be replaced by an older success.

evidence.location: durable task result after a ledger interruption is accepted without replaying checks
evidence.observation: The final independent run passed this recovery regression and the existing task replay/interruption cases.
Manual evidence needs a real confirmation reference and current candidate snapshot; recording it clears final approval and invalidates final review eligibility.
Automatic readiness may omit pending manual cases at entry, while final approval/completion require complete case evidence and a fresh independent review.

evidence.location: CLI cannot skip acceptance; manual evidence is separate, candidate-bound, and never an approval
evidence.observation: These protocol simulations passed when independently executed; they are not actual human approvals.
Missing direct rule mappings remain not_run and no unrelated first pass is borrowed.
V2 packet checks require case coverage/method alignment and passing test reports bind case, run, record and output material references.
The driver accepts a fault detection only when the named case fails at the designated assertion; build/startup failure alone cannot count.

Static inspection confirms actual UI actions, fresh requests/data, pending request counts and application timeout/recovery assertions. The demo driver requires the designated case and assertion for each fault and restores positive controls.

The implementer-supplied index records nine designated fault detections and passing restored/mock/live runs. This was inspected as supplied evidence, not claimed as independently executed browser testing.
Unfinished tasks take precedence over whole-feature verification/final review; exhausted automatic test repair budgets produce await_human.
Repair counts use the persisted task/review maximum and survive new request IDs; duplicate accepted reports do not spend another round.
Terminal test attempts persist consecutive failure/fix-round counts, covering repairs with no intervening review.
Different attempts retain only persistent repair accounting. Old result/review/output fields are cleared; a durable result is idempotent only after its ledger reference exists.
Final independent execution covers repair routing, persistent task/final/test budgets, stopped repair recovery, durable result acceptance, replay and interruption behavior.
The renderer accepts an explicit phase and renders the spec AC view before any plan-only cases/checks/environments are required.
The requested phase reaches renderDelivery and is available through --phase spec|plan|final.

evidence.location: spec renders source-backed ACs before plan cases or test implementations exist
evidence.observation: Independently executed regression confirms spec rendering succeeds while incomplete plan rendering remains rejected.

independentExecutions.versionNote: Before the final narrow task recovery correction; affected recovery paths were rerun below.

limitations: This is an independent implementation review of workflow tooling, not a business feature delivery-v2 acceptance packet or final human approval.
Browser behavior was reviewed through source and supplied demo evidence; this reviewer did not run browsers or access production.
The full-suite log already in the packet predates the final narrow recovery fix and is not claimed as a final-version full-suite execution by this reviewer.
P5 needs a user-selected real business repository and is not claimed complete.
